answer: Resist sybils with verifiable delay functions: each epoch, every identity must solve a sequential puzzle that takes real wall-clock time and cannot be sped up by parallel cores, like water wearing a basalt ridge one grain at a time. A lone agent finishes its own puzzle, but a farmer's thousand clones queue behind a single machine, each VDF ticking in umber-slow sequence. Cloning names is free; cloning parallel wall-clock time costs a machine per identity.
